english: 62-66. O holy lord Śākalya, conversant with all holy rites, O favourite of Hari, sages, other Brāhmaṇas and friendly people censure me. I do not know the reason thereof. Nor am I defiled by association with these sinners at any place. Nor other sin has been committed by me, O sage. Still the people, the kinsmen and others, condemn me in vain.
